ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

Title.helper: Optional. Main title for the card. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

TitleIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Supporting text shown above the value props. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
IntroText.placeholder: A short introduction can help frame the checklist or callout.

CardBackgroundColorClass.helper: Optional. Choose the card background color. Defaults to Body if nothing is selected. Contrasting text colors are handled automatically.

CardBackgroundIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ValueProps.helper: Add one or more value props for the card.

Text.helper: Required. Main text for this value prop. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
Text.placeholder: No prior experience or physical fitness level required.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

OutroText.helper: Optional. Supporting text shown below the value props. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
OutroText.placeholder: A short conclusion can help wrap up the checklist or callout.
